# Register application
{: .no_toc }

Register a new application.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `APL-02` |
| **Route** | `/dev/apps/new` · deep link `substratal://dev/apps/new` |
| **Where** | Developer › Applications |
| **Who can use it** | applications.manage, or anyone with a verified email (self-service) |
| **Kind** | wizard |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwDialog` with `AdwNavigationView` pages |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name | text-field | name |  | AdwEntryRow |
| Slug | text-field | slug | ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$; 'platform' reserved; immutable — warn | AdwEntryRow |
| Launch URL | url-field | launch_url | https | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=url |
| Redirect URIs | url-list | redirect_uris |  | AdwPreferencesGroup of AdwEntryRow + add button |
| Visibility | radio-group | visibility public \ | invite_only \ | GtkCheckButton group |
| Access tier | radio-group | access_tier free \ | standard (default standard) | GtkCheckButton group |
| Owner | select | owner_user_id \ | owner_organization_id | AdwComboRow |
| Icon | image-picker | icon_url |  | GtkFileDialog (portal) |
| Support URL | url-field | support_url |  | AdwEntryRow input-purpose=url |
| Email from name | text-field | email_from_name |  | AdwEntryRow |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Register | `POST /applications (Idempotency-Key)` | 409 slug taken; 422 field errors; 403 `email_not_verified` / `moderation_field_forbidden`; 429 → 10 a day. Staff registration grants the platform-managed Entitlements its access_tier calls for; a self-service app starts `pending_review` and is granted them only once approved (APL-06). |
